name: 450W Double Glass Solar Module
tagline: High-efficiency 450W module for residential, commercial and distributed solar projects.

benefits.title: N-Type Technology
benefits.description: N-type cells offer our advanced in-house cell technology with better performance and improved reliability, delivering an exceptional module efficiency of up to 23.04%.

benefits.title: Bifacial Power Gain
benefits.description: N-Type architecture increases bifaciality up to 80% ± 5% for a higher backside bonus and better lifetime yield, optimized by multi-busbar technology.

benefits.title: Low Temperature Coefficient
benefits.description: Features a highly competitive temperature coefficient (Pmax) of -0.290%/°C for the highest lifetime energy yield in all climates.

benefits.title: Industrial Grade Construction
benefits.description: Optimized dual-glass construction (2.0+2.0mm Tempered Glass) with a silver anodized aluminum alloy frame for the highest mechanical load resistance.

benefits.title: Protected Against All Environments
benefits.description: Certified to withstand humidity, heat, rain, marine environments, wind, hailstorms, and packed snow for reliable global deployment.

benefits.title: Warranty
benefits.description: 25-year product warranty and 30-year linear power warranty for maximum long-term investment protection.

description: Callsun CN450W is a 450W double glass solar module designed for B2B distributors, dealers and EPC installers who need reliable modules for repeatable rooftop and distributed generation projects.
